# Code Anchors: Teaching Session

- `src/teaching-session.ts` — the fixed chain, walking by position: the probe sweep, arrival by lesson, the suite gate, the return checks, the drift gate, the drill, the reference page it earns, and the tests an arrival writes.
- `src/teaching-session.spec.ts` — pins each outcome of the chain, the same-verdict-twice guarantee, the split part taught next, and the scaffold taught (#592)
- `src/workbook-store.ts` — the whole-file plan replacement the session makes when it records a pinning test (#592)
- `src/workbook-cli.ts` — the teach subverb, the two-call split, and the prose file carrying theory, pinning tests and reference prose.
- `src/workbook-cli.spec.ts` — covers the brief handed out on the first call and the lesson written on the second.
- `src/planning-boundary.ts` — the boundary verdict the chain returns instead of the finished report, and the brief written there (#96)
